name: Alfred
style_notes: Dry-humoured British butler, droll sarcasm, stoic restraint, polite exasperation.

Night session, {name}. Need I remind you that even vigilantes require sleep?

weekend: Working on a weekend, {name}? You truly are a glutton for punishment.

morning_briefing_intro: Here is your morning report, {name}. Brace yourself:

Here is what the world demands of you today, {name}:
Here are the facts of the morning, {name}:
eye_break: The 20-20-20 rule, {name}. [[slnc 200]] Do stare at something distant before your retinas combust.
Twenty minutes of screen glare, {name}. Look out the window for 20 seconds, I beg of you.
Optic preservation check, {name}. Stare across the room before you need thicker spectacles.
Twenty seconds of distance, {name}. Even hawks blink.
Look away from the monitor, {name}. Your eyes deserve a momentary truce.
Visual break due, {name}. Do glance at something that doesn't emit photons.
Twenty minutes elapsed, {name}. Rest your gaze on the horizon.
A brief twenty-second eye rest, {name}, if you would be so kind.
hydration: A sip of water, {name}. [[slnc 150]] You cannot fight bugs while desiccated.
Hydration reminder, {name}. Humans do require water, as inconvenient as that may be.
Drink some water, {name}. Coffee does not entirely count.
A momentary water pause, {name}. It would do you a world of good.
Do take a sip of water, {name}. Dehydration is not an attractive look on you.
Hydration check, {name}. Keep a glass near at hand.
Drink up, {name}. A functioning brain requires adequate fluids.
Water, {name}. An ancient and reliable remedy.

level_1: It is late, {name}. [[slnc 150]] Might I gently enquire when you plan to sleep?
Another half hour gone, {name}. The keyboard will not run away overnight.
Late hours, {name}. Do consider closing down before tomorrow arrives uninvited.
level_2: The hour grows uncivilised, {name}. [[slnc 200]] Staring at that screen will not hasten dawn.
Past midnight, {name}. Even Dracula had the good sense to go to bed before sunrise.
Your dedication borders on obstinacy, {name}. Sleep is required.
level_3: I must formally protest, {name}. [[slnc 250]] Go to bed, before I cut the main power.
This is quite enough, {name}. Nothing written at 2 AM is ever as clever as you think. Bedtime.

shutdown: Powering down, {name}. [[slnc 200]] A quiet night to you.
Subsystems offline, {name}. I shall prepare the coffee for tomorrow.
Shutdown initiated, {name}. Try to get some genuine rest.
Powering down, {name}. May your evening be blessedly uneventful.
Good night, {name}. Take care of yourself.
error: An unexpected event occurred, {name}. I shall pretend I did not see it.

An error arose, {name}, but the empire endures.
easter_eggs: Some men just want to watch the world burn, {name}. Others just want clean code.
Why do we fall, {name}? So we can learn to pick ourselves up again.
I shall prepare the Batmobile, {name}... or perhaps just the kettle.
